311_service_requests: Holds 311 service request incidents; grain = one row per service request (unique_key); keys/measures include unique_key, created_date, closed_date, agency, agency_name, complaint_type, descriptor, location_type, incident_zip, incident_address, street_name, intersection_street_1, intersection_street_2, address_type, city, landmark, facility_type, status, due_date, resolution_description, resolution_action_updated_date, community_board, borough, x_coordinate, y_coordinate, park_facility_name, park_borough, bbl, open_data_channel_type, vehicle_type, taxi_company_borough, taxi_pickup_location, bridge_highway_name, bridge_highway_direction, road_ramp, bridge_highway_segment, latitude, longitude
citibike_stations: Contains Citibike station status and metadata; grain = one row per station (station_id); keys/measures include station_id, name, short_name, latitude, longitude, region_id, rental_methods, capacity, eightd_has_key_dispenser, num_bikes_available, num_bikes_disabled, num_docks_available, num_docks_disabled, is_installed, is_renting, is_returning, eightd_has_available_keys, last_reported
citibike_trips: Records Citibike trip events; grain = one row per trip; keys/measures include tripduration, starttime, stoptime, start_station_id, start_station_name, start_station_latitude, start_station_longitude, end_station_id, end_station_name, end_station_latitude, end_station_longitude, bikeid, usertype, birth_year, gender, customer_plan
nypd_mv_collisions: Stores motor vehicle collision reports; grain = one row per collision incident (unique_key); keys/measures include unique_key, timestamp, borough, on_street_name, off_street_name, cross_street_name, zip_code, latitude, longitude, location, contributing_factor_vehicle_1..5, vehicle_type_code1..5, number_of_persons_injured, number_of_persons_killed, number_of_cyclist_injured, number_of_cyclist_killed, number_of_motorist_injured, number_of_motorist_killed, number_of_pedestrians_injured, number_of_pedestrians_killed
station_complexes: Mapper of station complexes; grain = one row per complex (complex_id); keys/measures include complex_id, complex_name, PARTITION, CLUSTER
station_entrances: Details subway station entrances; grain = one row per entrance (implicit by entrance_lat/entrance_lon and station_name); keys/measures include division, line, station_name, station_lat, station_lon, route_1..route_11, entrance_type, staff, staff_hours, ada_notes, free_crossover, north_south_street, east_west_street, corner, entrance_lat, entrance_lon, entry, exit_only, vending, ada_compliant, station_geom, entrance_geom, PARTITION, CLUSTER
trips: GTFS trips table listing service trips; grain = one row per trip (trip_id); keys/measures include route_id, service_id, trip_id, trip_headsign, direction_id, block_id, shape_id, PARTITION, CLUSTER
geo_nyc_borough_boundaries: Geographic boundaries for NYC boroughs; grain = one row per borough (borough_code/name); keys/measures include borough_code, borough_name, borough_area, borough_len, borough_geom, PARTITION, CLUSTER
subway_ridership_2013_present: Annual ridership summary by station for 2013–2018; grain = one row per station (station_name); keys/measures include station_name, routes, ridership_2013, ridership_2014, ridership_2015, ridership_2016, ridership_2017, ridership_2018, change_2018_raw, change_2018_percent, rank_ridership_2018, PARTITION, CLUSTER
stop_times: GTFS stop times for trips; grain = one row per trip-stop occurrence (trip_id + stop_sequence); keys/measures include trip_id, arrival_time, departure_time, stop_id, stop_sequence, stop_headsign, pickup_type, dropoff_type, shape_dist_traveled, PARTITION, CLUSTER
routes: GTFS routes definitions; grain = one row per route (route_id); keys/measures include route_id, route_short_name, route_long_name, route_describe, route_type, PARTITION, CLUSTER
stations: Subway station metadata; grain = one row per station (station_id); keys/measures include station_id, complex_id, gtfs_stop_id, division, line, station_name, borough_name, daytime_routes, structure, north_direction_label, south_direction_label, station_lat, station_lon, station_geom, PARTITION, CLUSTER
tlc_yellow_trips_<N>: Yellow taxi trip records; grain = one row per taxi trip (columns: vendor_id, pickup_datetime, dropoff_datetime, passenger_count, trip_distance, rate_code, store_and_fwd_flag, payment_type, fare_amount, extra, mta_tax, tip_amount, tolls_amount, imp_surcharge, total_amount, pickup_location_id, dropoff_location_id, data_file_year, data_file_month).
tlc_green_trips_<N>: Green taxi (Boro/Green) trip records; grain = one row per taxi trip (columns: vendor_id, pickup_datetime, dropoff_datetime, store_and_fwd_flag, rate_code, passenger_count, trip_distance, fare_amount, extra, mta_tax, tip_amount, tolls_amount, ehail_fee, airport_fee, total_amount, payment_type, distance_between_service, time_between_service, trip_type, imp_surcharge, pickup_location_id, dropoff_location_id, data_file_year, data_file_month).
tlc_fhv_trips_<N>: For-hire vehicle location mapping; grain = one row per location record (columns: location_id, pickup_datetime, dispatching_base_num, borough, zone, service_zone).
taxi_zone_geom: Taxi zone geometries; grain = one row per taxi zone (columns: zone_id, zone_name, borough, zone_geom).
tree_census_<N>: Street tree census observations; grain = one row per surveyed tree (columns: recordid, address, house_number, street, zip_original, cb_original, site, species, diameter, status, wires, sidewalk_condition, support_structure, borough, x, y, longitude, latitude, cb_new, zip_new, censustract_2010, censusblock_2010, nta_2010, segmentid, spc_common, spc_latin, location).
tree_species: Tree species reference; grain = one row per species (columns: species_scientific_name, species_common_name, form, growth_rate, fall_color, environmental_tolerances, location_tolerances, notes_suggested_cultivars, tree_size, comments).
